decision.reopen_trigger: A dated The5ers changelog or comparable official rule revision naming the changed percentage, loss limit, target, eligibility or effective cohort, plus an independent public non-directional consistency/headroom calculation request. Assess any qualifying item against existing prop-rule content for refresh before new creation.
